turn.content: Records are clear: the only goods receipt on PO-2026-0139 records 4 Stretch Film units, and clause KTR-V-019#4.2 allows billing only for goods actually received and recorded. No earlier invoices exist on this PO, so this is a short delivery, not a resubmission.

tool_calls.name: submit_report
tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "quantity_exceeds_received", "line": 4, "cause": "short_delivery", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0139", "detail": "Line 'Stretch Film 500mm (rol)' ordered 12 units at 94,500."}, {"kind": "goods_receipt", "ref": "GR-2026-0139", "detail": "Only 4 units of Stretch Film 500mm (rol) received on 2026-10-04; all other PO lines received in full."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "INV/2026/10/0354", "detail": "Line 4 bills 12 x 94,500 = 1,134,000, i.e. 8 units more than the 4 received."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-019#4.2", "detail": "Vendor may only invoice goods actually received and recorded in a goods receipt."}], "explanation": "The single goods receipt on this purchase order records only 4 Stretch Film units against the 12 invoiced, and no earlier invoice exists on PO-2026-0139, so this invoice bills goods that have not yet been delivered."}]}
